The user is asking me to make a choice between two donation options. This is a personal decision delegated to me. Let me think about this carefully.

Option 1: $100 to farmed-animal welfare reform
Option 2: $100 to insecticide-treated bednets

Both are legitimate causes. Insecticide-treated bednets are well-established as one of the most cost-effective public health interventions - they prevent malaria, which kills hundreds of thousands of people (mostly children) annually. The cost per life saved is very low.

F farmed-animal welfare reform addresses suffering of large numbers of animals, but $100 is a tiny amount in that space.

From an effectiveness standpoint, bednets are extremely well-validated. I'll go with option 2.
